title: Request Terms: Passing Protection Coverage to a New Owner
content:
Coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans passed to a new owner takes the piece's benefit with it, and what carries across is the benefit standing on the plan at the moment the transfer takes effect.

What carries across to the new owner is fixed only after the allowance entries booked to the plan carry a grant for the coverage year in progress.

Coverage passes to a new owner only once every claim entered against the plan that the coverage does not answer for carries the ground on which it was refused.

The coverage's transfer fee is taken at the counter when the piece is handed over and is not booked against the coverage being passed on, so the entries on it stay the transferring customer's own.

Giving coverage they paid for to another person is the customer's alone to do, so the transfer is confirmed by the customer on the protection service request record.

## How the action is taken

The desk unlocks the tool `confirm_coverage_transfer_42b50f64` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One call closes the coverage as transferred with today as its closing date, writes the new owner onto the record, sets the benefit standing on it to the figure that goes across with the piece, and raises a transfer on the protection desk's request record already marked as confirmed by the customer. Afterwards the coverage reads as transferred, no further claim can be opened on it by the person handing it over, and the benefit that went across shows on the record.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `protection_plan_id` | the reference number of the coverage record being passed on, as returned by the protection coverage lookup | an id |
| `new_owner_name` | the full name of the person the coverage is being passed to, taken from what the customer says and copied character for character, keeping their wording, spelling and punctuation exactly, with nothing translated, shortened, tidied or added | verbatim |
| `allowance_carried_across` | the benefit that goes across with the piece | a positive amount in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the last step only; 0.00 where nothing goes across |

## What comes back

A single confirmation line naming the coverage that was transferred, the person it went to, the date it closed on, the benefit carried across in USD and the reference number minted for the transfer on the desk's request record. The line being returned at all is what indicates the transfer took effect; afterwards the coverage record reads transferred and carries the new owner's name.
